representative_scale.gpu_class: One H100, A100 or A10-class NVIDIA GPU; use same physical GPU for baseline and candidate. Exact available model unknown.
representative_scale.scale_policy: Fixed supplied scale; no searches, doubling loops or smaller-workload extrapolation.

inputs.source: brief.md (supplied research brief; embedded dhfr_ensemble.py driver)

outputs.full_energy_series_reason: Supplied driver samples energies every 250 steps internally but serializes only mean and final values. Full-series identity cannot be audited from its JSON alone.

timing_scope.ensemble_start: After PDB/force-field/System/platform preparation, immediately before replica loop.
timing_scope.ensemble_end: After final replica Context/integrator destruction, before output serialization.
included: Context construction and CUDA initialization/compilation within replica loop
timing_scope.per_replica_wall_s: Starts after Context setup and velocity initialization; includes integration and energy sampling, excludes context setup and teardown.
timing_scope.candidate_comparison: Measure entire eight-replica completion including corresponding context setup and teardown; include process orchestration within candidate ensemble interval and report any MPS setup separately.

scoring_interface.scientific_outputs: Match replica ids, seeds, step counts, final and mean potential energy in kJ/mol. Full-series equality requires additional instrumentation.
scoring_interface.reason: No independently published fixed-work energy acceptance bound. Brief predictions are hypotheses; same-seed run-to-run variability is unmeasured.
scoring_interface.anchor_interface: anchors.json contains only independent published reference; tolerance null prevents pass/fail scoring against approximate throughput.
comparison_preconditions: Same single GPU model and device
Same work, precision and deterministic-force properties
scoring_interface.repeat_count_reason: No published repeat count or confidence rule for fixed-work ensemble.
scoring_interface.repeatability: Force determinism documented for CUDA; whole stochastic-trajectory identity under concurrency unverified. CPU platform trial described in brief was nondeterministic.

runtime_evidence.expected_runtime: Brief estimates roughly one minute on H100 and a few minutes on slower GPUs; not independently measured.
runtime_evidence.source: brief.md (supplied research brief; embedded dhfr_ensemble.py driver)
runtime_evidence.budget_fit_reason: Default budgets exceed brief runtime estimates, but no CUDA reproduction performed.
